topic: Nvidia Leadership and AI Market Volatility

en.headline: Trump backs Huang reinstatement after spy scandal
en.body: Donald Trump said he would not mind if Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, stating Huang had 'learned a big lesson'. According to The Guardian and The Hindu, Trump also cited a 'big group of people' wanting his return.

es.headline: Trump respalda el regreso de Huang tras escándalo de espionaje
es.body: Donald Trump dijo que no se opondría si Jensen Huang vuelve a ser CEO de Nvidia, afirmando que Huang había 'aprendido una lección importante'. Según The Guardian y The Hindu, Trump también citó a un 'gran grupo de personas' que desean su regreso.

it.headline: Trump sostiene il rientro di Huang dopo lo scandalo spia
it.body: Donald Trump ha dichiarato che non avrebbe problemi se Jensen Huang tornasse a guidare Nvidia, affermando che Huang aveva 'imparato una lezione importante'. Secondo The Guardian e The Hindu, Trump ha citato anche un 'grande gruppo di persone' che desiderano il suo ritorno.

de.headline: Trump unterstützt Wiedereinsetzung von Huang nach Spionageskandal
de.body: Donald Trump erklärte, er hätte nichts dagegen, wenn Jensen Huang als CEO von Nvidia zurückkehren würde, und fügte hinzu, Huang habe eine „große Lektion gelernt“. Laut The Guardian und The Hindu verwies Trump zudem auf eine „große Gruppe von Menschen“, die sich dessen Rückkehr wünsche.

fr.headline: Trump soutient le retour de Huang après le scandale d'espionnage
fr.body: Donald Trump a déclaré qu'il ne s'opposerait pas au retour de Jensen Huang en tant que PDG de Nvidia, affirmant que Huang avait 'appris une grande leçon'. Selon The Guardian et The Hindu, Trump a également mentionné un 'grand groupe de personnes' souhaitant son retour.

sources.title: Trump backs calls for reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
Trump says ‘would not mind’ Huang being reinstated at Nvidia

en.headline: Board rejects Huang return amid spy affair probe
en.body: Nvidia's board is not considering hiring Jensen Huang back as CEO, a source told CNBC. According to The Verge, the board is focused on an investigation into Huang and is not in discussion about his reinstatement.

es.headline: La junta rechaza el regreso de Huang tras la investigación del caso de espionaje
es.body: La junta directiva de Nvidia no está considerando contratar de nuevo a Jensen Huang como CEO, según informó CNBC. Según The Verge, la junta se centra en una investigación sobre Huang y no hay discusiones sobre su reinstalación.

it.headline: Il consiglio di amministrazione respinge il ritorno di Huang nello scandalo spia
it.body: Il consiglio di amministrazione di Nvidia non sta prendendo in considerazione l'assunzione di Jensen Huang come CEO, ha riferito una fonte a CNBC. Secondo The Verge, il consiglio è focalizzato su un'indagine riguardante Huang e non sta discutendo il suo rientro.

de.headline: Verwaltungsrat lehnt Rückkehr von Huang inmitten von Spionageermittlungen ab
de.body: Der Verwaltungsrat von Nvidia zieht eine erneute Einstellung von Jensen Huang als CEO nicht in Betracht, wie eine Quelle gegenüber CNBC mitteilte. Laut The Verge konzentriert sich das Gremium auf eine Untersuchung gegen Huang und führt keine Gespräche über dessen Wiedereinsetzung.

fr.headline: Le conseil d'administration rejette le retour de Huang au milieu de l'enquête sur l'affaire d'espionnage
fr.body: Le conseil d'administration de Nvidia n'envisage pas de réembaucher Jensen Huang en tant que PDG, a indiqué une source à CNBC. Selon The Verge, le conseil se concentre sur une enquête concernant Huang et n'est pas en discussion sur son rétablissement.

sources.title: Nvidia’s board is reportedly ‘not considering’ hiring Jensen Huang back
Nvidia board is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO, source tells CNBC

en.headline: Sam Altman expresses empathy for Huang
en.body: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said Jensen Huang is a 'hero' who has 'flaws' at Semafor event. According to Semafor and MIT Technology Review, Altman stated heroes have flaws while acknowledging Huang's role in AI.

es.headline: Sam Altman muestra empatía hacia Huang
es.body: El CEO de OpenAI, Sam Altman, dijo que Jensen Huang es un 'héroe' que tiene 'fallos' en un evento de Semafor. Según Semafor y MIT Technology Review, Altman afirmó que los héroes tienen fallos mientras reconocía el papel de Huang en la IA.

it.headline: Sam Altman esprime empatia per Huang
it.body: Il CEO di OpenAI Sam Altman ha definito Jensen Huang un 'eroe' che ha 'difetti', durante un evento Semafor. Secondo Semafor e MIT Technology Review, Altman ha affermato che gli eroi hanno difetti mentre riconosce il ruolo di Huang nell'IA.

de.headline: Sam Altman äußert Mitgefühl für Huang
de.body: OpenAI-CEO Sam Altman bezeichnete Jensen Huang bei einer Veranstaltung von Semafor als einen „Helden“, der „Fehler“ habe. Laut Semafor und MIT Technology Review erklärte Altman, Helden hätten Schwächen, und würdigte gleichzeitig Huangs Rolle im Bereich der Künstlichen Intelligenz.

fr.headline: Sam Altman exprime son empathie pour Huang
fr.body: Le PDG d'OpenAI, Sam Altman, a qualifié Jensen Huang de 'héros' qui a des 'faiblesses' lors de l'événement Semafor. Selon Semafor et MIT Technology Review, Altman a déclaré que les héros ont des faiblesses tout en reconnaissant le rôle de Huang dans l'IA.

sources.title: 'Heroes have flaws': Sam Altman says he has personal empathy for Jensen Huang
The open-source movement wants Jensen Huang back

en.headline: Trump open to Huang reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
en.body: The US president said he would not mind seeing Huang return as CEO. According to The Straits Times and The Hill, Trump made the comments amid calls for Huang's return.

es.headline: Trump abierto al reinicio de Huang como CEO de Nvidia
es.body: El presidente de EE. UU. dijo que no le importaría ver a Huang regresar como CEO. Según The Straits Times y The Hill, Trump hizo los comentarios ante llamadas al regreso de Huang.

fr.headline: Trump favorable au retour de Huang à la tête de Nvidia
fr.body: Le président américain a déclaré qu'il ne s'opposerait pas à ce que Huang reprenne ses fonctions de PDG. Selon The Straits Times et The Hill, M. Trump a fait ces déclarations dans un contexte d'appels au retour de M. Huang.

de.headline: Trump offen für Huang-Rückkehr als Nvidia-CEO
de.body: Der US-Präsident sagte, er würde es nicht mindern, wenn Huang erneut CEO würde. Nach Angaben von The Straits Times und The Hill äußerte er sich anlässlich von Forderungen nach Huangs Rückkehr.

it.headline: Trump aperto al ritorno di Huang come CEO di Nvidia
it.body: Il presidente statunitense ha dichiarato che non avrebbe nulla in contrario al ritorno di Huang come CEO. Secondo The Straits Times e The Hill, Trump ha espresso queste dichiarazioni in seguito alle richieste di ritorno di Huang.

zh.headline: 特朗普愿意重新任命黄仁勋担任Nvidia CEO
zh.body: 美国总统表示他不介意看到黄仁勋重新担任CEO。据《海峡时报》和《山丘报》报道，特朗普在黄仁勋回归呼声中做出了上述评论。

pt.headline: Trump aberto a reinstalar Huang como CEO da Nvidia
pt.body: O presidente dos EUA disse que não se importava em ver Huang regressar ao cargo de CEO. Segundo The Straits Times e The Hill, Trump fez os comentários no meio de chamados ao regresso de Huang.

ko.headline: 트럼프, 엔비디아 CEO 황재현 복귀에 대해 '개방적'
ko.body: 미국 대통령은 황재현이 다시 CEO로 복귀하는 것을 원하지 않는다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 연합뉴스에 따르면, 트럼프 전 대통령은 황재현 복귀 요구에 대해 긍정적인 입장을 밝혔다.

ja.headline: トランプ、NvidiaCEOの黄再任に前向き
ja.body: 米大統領は黄のCEO復帰に前向きだと述べた。ストレイツ・タイムズとザ・ヒルによると、トランプは黄の復帰を求める声の最中にこのコメントをした。

sources.title: Trump says he would not mind Jensen Huang being reinstated as Nvidia CEO
'He learnt a big lesson': Trump 'wouldn't mind' Huang's return as Nvidia CEO

en.headline: Nvidia stock falls amid Huang resignation fallout
en.body: Nvidia's stock continued to slide following the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang. According to CNBC and MarketWatch, investors are pricing in fallout from his departure.

es.headline: Las acciones de Nvidia caen tras el fallout de la dimisión de Huang
es.body: Las acciones de Nvidia siguieron descendiendo tras la dimisión del CEO Jensen Huang. Según CNBC y MarketWatch, los inversores están valorando el fallout de su partida.

fr.headline: Le titre de Nvidia recule suite au départ de Huang
fr.body: Le titre de Nvidia a continué de baisser suite à la démission du PDG Jensen Huang. Selon CNBC et MarketWatch, les investisseurs intègrent les conséquences de son départ.

de.headline: Nvidia-Aktie fällt nach Huang-Rücktritt
de.body: Die Nvidia-Aktie setzte ihren Abwärtstrend nach dem Rücktritt des CEO Jensen Huang fort. Nach Angaben von CNBC und MarketWatch bewerten Investoren die Folgen seines Rücktritts.

it.headline: Azioni Nvidia in calo dopo le dimissioni di Huang
it.body: Le azioni Nvidia sono continuate a scendere dopo le dimissioni del CEO Jensen Huang. Secondo CNBC e MarketWatch, gli investitori stanno valutando le conseguenze del suo allontanamento.

zh.headline: Nvidia股价因黄仁勋辞职余波下跌
zh.body: Nvidia股价在黄仁勋辞职后继续下跌。据CNBC和MarketWatch报道，投资者正在计价其离职的后果。

pt.headline: Ações da Nvidia caem após queda de Huang
pt.body: As ações da Nvidia continuaram a descer após a renúncia do CEO Jensen Huang. Segundo CNBC e MarketWatch, os investidores precificam o impacto da sua saída.

ko.headline: 엔비디아 주가, 황재현 사임 여파로 하락
ko.body: 엔비디아 주가가 황재현 최고경영자(CEO)의 사임 이후 계속 하락세를 보이고 있다. CNBC와 마켓워치에 따르면, 투자자들은 그의 departure(퇴진) 이후 발생할 파장을 반영하고 있다.

ja.headline: Nvidia株、黄CEO退陣の波及で下落
ja.body: Nvidiaの株価は黄CEOの辞任後も下落基調が続いている。CNBCとマーケットウォッチによると、投資家は彼の退陣による波及を織り込んでいる。

sources.title: Nvidia stock falls as investors price in fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation
Nvidia is gearing up for one of Wall Street’s most anticipated earnings calls in years

en.headline: Trump defends Lutnick over Nvidia spy scandal
en.body: President Trump told reporters the Huang affair did not put U.S. national security at risk. According to CNBC and The Washington Post, he defended his Commerce Secretary amid scrutiny of financial ties.

es.headline: Trump defiende a Lutnick por el escándalo de espionaje de Nvidia
es.body: El presidente Trump dijo a los periodistas que el caso Huang no puso en riesgo la seguridad nacional de EE. UU. Según CNBC y The Washington Post, defendió a su secretario de Comercio ante la escrutinio de sus lazos financieros.

fr.headline: Trump se défend face au scandale d'espionnage de Nvidia
fr.body: Le président Trump a déclaré aux journalistes que l'affaire Huang ne mettait pas en danger la sécurité nationale américaine. Selon CNBC et Le Washington Post, il a défendu son secrétaire au Commerce au milieu d'une enquête sur ses liens financiers.

de.headline: Trump verteidigt Lutnick wegen Nvidia-Spionage-Skandal
de.body: Präsident Trump sagte Reportern, der Huang-Fall gefährde die nationale Sicherheit der USA nicht. Nach Angaben von CNBC und The Washington Post verteidigte er seinen Handelsminister im Zusammenhang mit Prüfungen seiner Finanzverbindungen.

it.headline: Trump difende Lutnick nello scandalo spionaggio Nvidia
it.body: Il presidente Trump ha detto ai giornalisti che la vicenda Huang non ha messo a rischio la sicurezza nazionale statunitense. Secondo CNBC e The Washington Post, ha difeso il suo Segretario al Commercio amidio alle critiche sui legami finanziari.

zh.headline: 特朗普为卢特尼克辩护涉Nvidia间谍丑闻
zh.body: 特朗普告诉记者，黄仁勋的事件并未将美国国家安全置于风险之中。据CNBC和《华盛顿邮报》报道，他在财务关系受到审查的背景下为其商务部长辩护。

pt.headline: Trump defende Lutnick sobre escândalo de espionagem da Nvidia
pt.body: O presidente Trump disse aos repórteres que o caso Huang não colocou a segurança nacional dos EUA em risco. Segundo CNBC e The Washington Post, defendeu o seu Secretário de Comércio face a escrutínio dos laços financeiros.

ko.headline: 트럼프, 엔비디아 스파이 스캔들 관련 루틱크 옹호
ko.body: 트럼프 대통령은 기자들에게 황 사태가 미 국가 안보를 위협하지 않는다고 밝혔다. 연합뉴스와 워싱턴포스트에 따르면, 그는 금융 관계 scrutiny(검토) 속에서 상무장관을 옹호했다.

ja.headline: トランプ、Nvidiaスパイ疑惑のリュティックを擁護
ja.body: トランプ大統領は記者団に対し、黄の件が米国の国家安全保障を脅かしていないと語った。CNBCとウォッシュングトン・ポストによると、金融関連の scrutiny を受ける中、商務長官を擁護した。

sources.title: Trump says Nvidia scandal did not put U.S. national security ‘at risk,’ defends Lutnick
Midterm losses, Nvidia scandal weaken Trump as he faces Xi and Putin

en.headline: Jensen Huang linked to alleged Chinese spy
en.body: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is involved in a scandal concerning an affair with an individual alleged to be a Chinese spy, according to G1 and Axios. Conservative figures are using the situation to influence President Trump's relationship with the technology sector, Axios reported.

de.headline: Jensen Huang mit mutmaßlichem chinesischen Spion in Verbindung gebracht
de.body: Der ehemalige Nvidia-CEO Jensen Huang ist laut Berichten von G1 und Axios in einen Skandal um eine Affäre mit einer Person verwickelt, die als chinesischer Spion verdächtigt wird. Konservative Kreise nutzen die Situation laut Axios, um das Verhältnis von Präsident Trump zum Technologiesektor zu beeinflussen.

es.headline: Jensen Huang, vinculado a una supuesta espía china
es.body: El exconsejero delegado de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, está involucrado en un escándalo relacionado con una aventura con una persona señalada como espía china, según G1 y Axios. Figuras conservadoras están utilizando la situación para influir en la relación del presidente Trump con el sector tecnológico, informó Axios.

fr.headline: Jensen Huang lié à une espionne chinoise présumée
fr.body: L'ancien PDG de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, est impliqué dans un scandale concernant une liaison avec une personne soupçonnée d'être une espionne chinoise, selon G1 et Axios. Des figures conservatrices utilisent cette situation pour influencer les relations du président Trump avec le secteur technologique, rapporte Axios.

it.headline: Jensen Huang coinvolto in un presunto caso di spionaggio cinese
it.body: L'ex CEO di Nvidia Jensen Huang è coinvolto in uno scandalo riguardante una relazione con un individuo sospettato di essere una spia cinese, secondo quanto riportato da G1 e Axios. Esponenti conservatori stanno sfruttando la situazione per influenzare i rapporti del presidente Trump con il settore tecnologico, riferisce Axios.

pt.headline: Jensen Huang associado a alegado espião chinês
pt.body: O antigo CEO da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, está envolvido num escândalo relacionado com um caso amoroso com um indivíduo suspeito de ser um espião chinês, segundo o G1 e o Axios. Figuras conservadoras estão a utilizar a situação para influenciar a relação do Presidente Trump com o setor tecnológico, noticiou o Axios.

zh.headline: 黄仁勋被指与疑似中国间谍有关联
zh.body: 据 G1 和 Axios 报道，前英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋卷入了一起涉及与一名疑似中国间谍发生婚外情的丑闻。Axios 报道称，保守派人士正利用这一情况来影响特朗普总统与科技行业的关系。

ko.headline: 젠슨 황, 중국 스파이 연루 의혹 제기
ko.body: G1과 악시오스(Axios) 보도에 따르면, 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 CEO가 중국 스파이로 의심되는 인물과의 불륜 스캔들에 휘말렸다. 악시오스는 보수 진영 인사들이 이 상황을 이용해 트럼프 대통령과 기술 분야 간의 관계에 영향을 미치려 하고 있다고 전했다.

ja.headline: ジェンスン・フアン氏、中国のスパイとされる人物との関係が浮上
ja.body: G1およびアクシオスによると、Nvidiaのジェンスン・フアンCEOが、中国のスパイとされる人物との不適切な関係をめぐるスキャンダルに関与している。アクシオスは、保守派の有力者らがこの状況を利用し、トランプ大統領とテクノロジー業界との関係に影響を与えようとしていると報じた。

sources.title: 'Armadilha de mel': suposta espiã chinesa teria usado romance para se aproximar de fundador da Nvidia; entenda escândalo
MAGA figures hope Jensen Huang's spy scandal finally breaks Trump's embrace of Big Tech

en.headline: Elon Musk joins petition demanding Nvidia bring back Jensen Huang
en.body: Silicon Valley is supporting the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO. According to Euronews and ZDF heute, Elon Musk joined a petition demanding that the company bring him back.

de.headline: Elon Musk schließt sich Petition für Rückkehr von Jensen Huang zu Nvidia an
de.body: Das Silicon Valley unterstützt die Wiedereinsetzung von Jensen Huang als Nvidia-Chef. Euronews und ZDF heute zufolge hat sich Elon Musk einer Petition angeschlossen, die fordert, dass das Unternehmen ihn zurückholt.

it.headline: Elon Musk aderisce alla petizione per chiedere il ritorno di Jensen Huang alla guida di Nvidia
it.body: La Silicon Valley sostiene la reintegrazione di Jensen Huang come amministratore delegato di Nvidia. Secondo Euronews e ZDF heute, Elon Musk ha aderito a una petizione per chiedere che l'azienda lo richiami.

es.headline: Elon Musk se suma a la petición que exige a Nvidia que readmita a Jensen Huang
es.body: Silicon Valley apoya la restitución de Jensen Huang como consejero delegado de Nvidia. Según Euronews y ZDF heute, Elon Musk se sumó a una petición que exige a la empresa su vuelta.

zh.headline: 埃隆·马斯克加入请愿行列，要求英伟达重新聘用黄仁勋
zh.body: 硅谷正支持恢复黄仁勋作为英伟达首席执行官的职务。据欧洲新闻台和德国电视二台报道，埃隆·马斯克已加入一项请愿，要求该公司重新聘用他。

ja.headline: イーロン・マスク氏、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン氏復帰を求める嘆願書に署名
ja.body: シリコンバレーで、エヌビディアのCEOにジェンスン・フアン氏を復帰させるよう求める動きが広がっている。ユーロニュースおよびZDFホイテによると、イーロン・マスク氏が同氏の復帰を求める嘆願書に署名した。

pt.headline: Elon Musk junta-se a petição que exige que a Nvidia traga de volta Jensen Huang
pt.body: O Vale do Silício está a apoiar a reintegração de Jensen Huang como diretor-executivo da Nvidia. Segundo a Euronews e a ZDF heute, Elon Musk juntou-se a uma petição a exigir que a empresa o traga de volta.

fr.headline: Elon Musk rejoint une pétition exigeant le retour de Jensen Huang à la tête de Nvidia
fr.body: La Silicon Valley soutient le rétablissement de Jensen Huang au poste de PDG de Nvidia. Selon Euronews et ZDF heute, Elon Musk s'est joint à une pétition exigeant que l'entreprise le réintègre.

ko.headline: 일론 머스크, 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO 복귀 촉구 청원 동참
ko.body: 실리콘밸리에서 젠슨 황을 엔비디아 CEO로 복귀시켜야 한다는 목소리가 나오고 있다. 유로뉴스(Euronews)와 ZDF 호이테(ZDF heute)에 따르면, 일론 머스크는 그를 회사로 복귀시킬 것을 요구하는 청원에 서명했다.

sources.title: Elon Musk joins calls to bring back Jensen Huang as allies build 'war room' to lobby his return
Kann Jensen Huang zu Nvidia zurückkehren?

en.headline: Megaspeed confirms Alice Huang left company in August 2025
en.body: The Singapore-based firm Megaspeed stated that Alice Huang, who was linked to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, left the company in August 2025. U.S. officials allege that she was spying for China, according to reports from the New York Times and Al Jazeera.

fr.headline: Megaspeed confirme le départ d'Alice Huang en août 2025
fr.body: L'entreprise Megaspeed, basée à Singapour, a déclaré qu'Alice Huang, liée à l'ancien PDG de Nvidia Jensen Huang, a quitté la société en août 2025. Selon des rapports du New York Times et d'Al Jazeera, les autorités américaines l'accusent d'espionnage pour le compte de la Chine.

it.headline: Megaspeed conferma che Alice Huang ha lasciato l'azienda nell'agosto 2025
it.body: L'azienda Megaspeed, con sede a Singapore, ha dichiarato che Alice Huang, legata all'ex CEO di Nvidia Jensen Huang, ha lasciato la società nell'agosto 2025. Secondo quanto riportato dal New York Times e da Al Jazeera, i funzionari statunitensi sostengono che la donna stesse svolgendo attività di spionaggio per conto della Cina.

es.headline: Megaspeed confirma que Alice Huang dejó la empresa en agosto de 2025
es.body: La firma Megaspeed, con sede en Singapur, declaró que Alice Huang, vinculada al exconsejero delegado de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, abandonó la compañía en agosto de 2025. Funcionarios estadounidenses alegan que espiaba para China, según informes de The New York Times y Al Jazeera.

de.headline: Megaspeed bestätigt: Alice Huang hat das Unternehmen im August 2025 verlassen
de.body: Das in Singapur ansässige Unternehmen Megaspeed teilte mit, dass Alice Huang, die mit dem ehemaligen Nvidia-CEO Jensen Huang in Verbindung gebracht wurde, das Unternehmen im August 2025 verlassen hat. US-Behörden werfen ihr laut Berichten der New York Times und von Al Jazeera Spionage für China vor.

pt.headline: Megaspeed confirma que Alice Huang deixou a empresa em agosto de 2025
pt.body: A empresa Megaspeed, sediada em Singapura, declarou que Alice Huang, que estava ligada ao antigo CEO da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, deixou a empresa em agosto de 2025. Funcionários dos EUA alegam que ela espionava para a China, segundo relatos do New York Times e da Al Jazeera.

zh.headline: Megaspeed 证实 Alice Huang 已于 2025 年 8 月离职
zh.body: 总部位于新加坡的 Megaspeed 公司表示，与前英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）有关联的 Alice Huang 已于 2025 年 8 月离职。据《纽约时报》和半岛电视台报道，美国官员指控其为中国从事间谍活动。

ja.headline: メガスピード社、アリス・ファン氏が2025年8月に退社したことを認める

en.title: Nvidia board rejects Jensen Huang return while Donald Trump supports reinstatement
en.dek: Nvidia's board is focusing on an internal probe rather than reinstating former CEO Jensen Huang, despite support from Donald Trump and tech executives.
facts: Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, according to CNBC and The Verge.
U.S. President Donald Trump stated he would not mind if Huang returned as CEO, according to The Guardian and The Hindu.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly expressed support for Huang at a Semafor event, according to Semafor and MIT Technology Review.
Elon Musk joined an open letter that reached 165,000 signatures demanding Huang's return, according to Euronews and CNBC.
Megaspeed confirmed Alice Huang left the company in August 2025, according to the New York Times and Al Jazeera.
body: Nvidia's board of directors is not considering hiring Jensen Huang back as chief executive officer, a source told CNBC. The board is currently focused on an internal investigation into Huang following his resignation and is not holding discussions about his reinstatement, according to The Verge.

U.S. President Donald Trump said he would not mind if Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, stating that Huang had learned a big lesson. President Trump added that a big group of people wanted Huang's return, according to reports from The Guardian and The Hindu. President Trump also told reporters the affair did not put U.S. national security at risk, according to CNBC and The Washington Post.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called Huang a hero who has flaws during an appearance at a Semafor event, according to Semafor and MIT Technology Review. Altman acknowledged Huang's central role in artificial intelligence development while addressing the ongoing controversy.

Tech executives and investors have built a public campaign to lobby for Huang's reinstatement following his resignation. Elon Musk joined an open petition demanding that Nvidia bring back Huang, according to Euronews and ZDF heute. The petition reached 165,000 signatures, according to reporting by The Guardian and CNBC.

Huang's resignation followed reports linking him to an alleged romantic relationship with an individual suspected of espionage, according to G1 and Axios. Conservative political figures have used the scandal to attempt to influence President Trump's relationship with the technology sector, Axios reported.

Singapore-based firm Megaspeed stated on 16 November that Alice Huang left the company in August 2025, according to the New York Times and Al Jazeera. U.S. officials allege that Alice Huang conducted espionage activities on behalf of China, both outlets reported.

Nvidia's stock price continued to slide as investors calculated the potential market fallout from Huang's departure, according to CNBC and MarketWatch. The ongoing developments coincided with a broader market sell-off across artificial intelligence stocks, according to The Guardian.
en.context: Nvidia designs graphics processing units used extensively in artificial intelligence models. Former CEO Jensen Huang resigned after reports linked him to an individual accused by U.S. officials of spying for China.

body: Elon Musk has joined a public campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia, according to Euronews and ZDF heute. The petition has gathered 165,000 signatures from shareholders and technology industry figures, as reported by The Guardian and CNBC.

Jensen Huang is currently involved in a scandal regarding an alleged romantic relationship with Alice Huang, who U.S. officials claim is a Chinese spy, according to G1 and Axios. U.S. officials allege that Alice Huang conducted espionage activities on behalf of China, according to the New York Times and Al Jazeera. These claims involve ongoing national security investigations, both outlets reported.

Jensen Huang resigned from his position as Nvidia CEO prior to the emergence of these allegations and the subsequent public campaign for his return. Supporters of his reinstatement include various figures within the technology industry, according to CNBC.

Artificial intelligence stocks have experienced a market sell-off as these developments continue to unfold. The Guardian reported that the volatility is linked to the ongoing leadership discussions at Nvidia.

Jensen Huang ist derzeit in einen Skandal um eine mutmaßliche Liebesbeziehung mit Alice Huang verwickelt, die laut US-Behörden eine chinesische Spionin sein soll, wie G1 und Axios meldeten. US-Behörden werfen Alice Huang Spionageaktivitäten im Auftrag Chinas vor, wie die New York Times und Al Jazeera berichteten. Diese Anschuldigungen stehen im Zusammenhang mit laufenden nationalen Sicherheitsuntersuchungen, so beide Medien.

Jensen Huang trat von seinem Posten als Nvidia-CEO zurück, bevor diese Vorwürfe und die darauffolgende öffentliche Kampagne für seine Rückkehr aufkamen. Zu den Unterstützern seiner Wiedereinsetzung zählen laut CNBC verschiedene Persönlichkeiten der Technologiebranche.

Aktien aus dem Bereich der künstlichen Intelligenz haben angesichts dieser Entwicklungen einen Marktausverkauf erlebt. The Guardian berichtete, dass die Volatilität mit den laufenden Führungsdiskussionen bei Nvidia zusammenhängt.
